flowchart TD
  %% ============ LAYERS / GROUPS ============
  subgraph S0[Part 0 — Setup]
    A0[Create folders: data/{raw,clean,index}]:::op
    A1[Dependency check & install\n(pandas, sklearn, imblearn, pypdf,\nfaiss-cpu, sentence-transformers,\nrank-bm25, tiktoken, lime)]:::op
    A2[Capability report]:::op
  end

  subgraph S1[Part 1 — PdM Model + LIME]
    B0[Load ai4i2020.csv]:::data
    B1[Feature engineering:\n temp_diff, rot_rads, power_W,\n overstrain_metric]:::op
    B2[Split & Scale]:::op
    B3[SMOTE (balance classes)]:::op
    B4[RandomForest → Calibrated (isotonic)]:::model
    B5[LIME explainer (tabular)]:::exp
    B6[Metrics: report, ROC AUC, AP]:::eval
  end

  subgraph S2[Part 2 — Manual Ingestion]
    C0[PDFs in data/raw or Reference_data]:::data
    C1[Extract text (pypdf)]:::op
    C2[Structure-first chunking\n(300–800 tokens, 10–20% overlap)]:::op
    C3[Attach metadata\n(manual_id, title, section, pages, revision, created_at)]:::op
    C4[Store chunks → SQLite 'chunks'\n+ write clean/*.txt]:::store
  end

  subgraph S3[Part 3 — Embeddings & Index]
    D0[Encode chunks]:::op
    D1{SentenceTransformers\navailable?}:::gate
    D2[FAISS index (L2)]:::index
    D3[TF-IDF Vectorizer + KNN\n(fallback)]:::index
    D4[BM25 keywords (optional)]:::index
  end

  subgraph S4[Part 4 — Retrieval Pipeline]
    E0[Build query from datapoint\n+ LIME top features\n+ USER_KEYWORDS]:::op
    E1[Vector search (FAISS or TF-IDF KNN)]:::op
    E2[BM25 blend + keyword boosts]:::op
    E3[Select Top-K (tunable)]:::op
    E4[Context packing\n(dedupe, token budget,\n preserve manual/section order)]:::op
  end

  subgraph S5[Part 5 — Two-Stage LLM (Ollama)]
    F0[(SYSTEM_MSG guardrails)]:::policy
    F1[Stage 1:\n“Failure or Normal?”\nJSON: short_answer, primary_cause,\n failure_keywords, signals, confidence]:::llm
    F2[Stage 2:\n“Why?” Grounded explanation\nJSON: answer, steps, cautions, citations,\n evidence_summary, conflicts,\n hallucination_check, maintenance_plan,\n confidence]:::llm
  end

  subgraph S6[Part 6 — Post-processing]
    G0[Validate JSON (schema)]:::check
    G1[Hallucination check\n(unsupported claims → warn/requery)]:::check
    G2[Format citations from metadata]:::op
    G3[Operator-first output\n(steps then deeper notes)]:::op
  end

  subgraph S7[Part 7 — Audio Output (TTS)]
    H0[Compose narration\n(answer+steps+cautions+citations)]:::op
    H1[pyttsx3 offline TTS\n→ data/audio/*.aiff|.wav]:::io
    H2[(Optional) Inline playback]:::io
  end

  %% ============ FLOWS ============
  A0 --> A1 --> A2
  A2 --> B0
  B0 --> B1 --> B2 --> B3 --> B4 --> B6
  B4 --> B5

  A2 --> C0
  C0 --> C1 --> C2 --> C3 --> C4

  C4 --> D0 --> D1
  D1 -- Yes --> D2
  D1 -- No  --> D3
  D0 --> D4

  %% Query path from a selected test sample
  B5 -. LIME top features .-> E0
  B4 --> E0
  D2 --> E1
  D3 --> E1
  D4 --> E2

  E0 --> E1 --> E2 --> E3 --> E4
  E4 --> F0 --> F1 --> F2
  F2 --> G0 --> G1 --> G2 --> G3
  G3 --> H0 --> H1 --> H2

  %% ============ STYLES ============
  classDef op fill:#eef7ff,stroke:#5aa2ff,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef data fill:#fff8e6,stroke:#f3b200,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef store fill:#f0fff0,stroke:#55aa55,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef model fill:#fff0f5,stroke:#ff6aa7,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef exp fill:#f4f0ff,stroke:#8a78ff,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef eval fill:#e8f9f1,stroke:#17a673,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef index fill:#f5fbff,stroke:#2e86de,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef llm fill:#fdf0e6,stroke:#ff7e00,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef policy fill:#ebebeb,stroke:#888,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:3 2;
  classDef gate fill:#fff,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:4 2;
  classDef check fill:#eaf7ff,stroke:#1f8dd6,stroke-width:1px;
  classDef io fill:#fff6fb,stroke:#d63384,stroke-width:1px;
